subject: rstanarm glmer error:  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

messages.author: 3fac22db78bd9c90
messages.subject: rstanarm glmer error:  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
Dear all,

When I try to run stan_glmer I get an error which seem to be outside of what I am able to influence. I cannot share the data, so it might be hard to reproduce. I am able to say that the data has about 10^6 rows and 2*10^5 different id's (as used in ``(1|id)``). The lme4 glmer function does run and produce results, but it complains about convergence.    

What might also be good to know is that the class of df_model is a data.table/data.frame.  

Thank you for your help.

prior_t = student_t(df = 6, 0, 2.5)
prior_c = decov()

mod2GLMBayes<-stan_glmer(df_model[pnrm<trpc,cbind(events,trials-events)]~x1+x2+x3+x4+x5+x6+(1|id),data=df_model[pnrm<trpc,],family=binomial(link="logit"), algorithm='sampling',
                              prior = prior_t,
                              prior_intercept = normal(0,1), prior_covariance=prior_c, chains=4, seed = 916031, verbose=TRUE, sample_file = paste0(folder,"sample2_file"), diagnostic_file = paste0(folder,"diagnostic2_file"), show_messages=paste0(folder,"show2_messages")
                              )

Error: 
Error in if (sparse) cbind2sparse(x, y) else cbind2(as(x, "denseMatrix"),  :
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning message:
In nr * (ncol(x) + ncol(y)) : NAs produced by integer overflow
trace:
.local(x, y, ...)
cbind2(Z, Matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = p[length(p)], sparse = FALSE))
cbind2(Z, Matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = p[length(p)], sparse = FALSE))
pad_reTrms(Z = Z, cnms = group$cnms, flist = group$flist)
stan_glm.fit(x = X, y = y, weights = weights, offset = offset,
    family = family, prior = prior, prior_intercept = prior_intercept,
    prior_ops = prior_ops, prior_PD = prior_PD, algorithm = algorithm,
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta, group = group, QR = QR, sparse = sparse,
    ...)
stan_glmer(... = paste0(folder, "show2_messages"))

rstanarm 2.13.1 will work with rstan 2.12.x and StanHeaders 2.12.x, although if updating is a big headache at your company, you might want to wait a few days for rstan 2.13.1 and StanHeaders 2.13.1 to be uploaded to CRAN.
